title: Find the Maximum Sequence Value of Array
sourceKind: third-party mirrors (official LeetCode page not fetched)
summary: For a subsequence of size 2k, its value is OR(first k elements) XOR OR(last k elements). Return the maximum value over subsequences of size 2k.
officialConstraints: 2 <= nums.length <= 400 and 1 <= nums[i] < 27 (from mirror summary). Visualization cap: n up to 20, values 1..26.
visualizationNotes: Visualization caps are listed in constraints; the DP table is shown in an 8 by 8 window that follows playback.
examplesNotes: The example nums=[4,2,5,6,7], k=2 -> 2 is from the mirror; one mirror page misstated the arithmetic, and (4 OR 5) XOR (6 OR 7) = 5 XOR 7 = 2 confirms it. The second check case [2,6,7], k=1 -> 5 is a derived check (not a statement example).
